mapper.select: select bo.seat_id seatId, ri.seat_code seatCode, ri.store_id storeId, ai.name storeName, count(*) orderCount, ifnull(sum(timestampdiff(hour, bo.start_date, bo.end_date)), 0) totalHours from booking_order bo join seat ri on ri.id = bo.seat_id and ri.is_deleted = 0 join study_store ai on ai.id = ri.store_id and ai.is_deleted = 0 where bo.is_deleted = 0 and bo.status != 3 group by bo.seat_id, ri.seat_code, ri.store_id, ai.name
